correctness.rationale: The source IF-SSPRK2 tableau reduces with constant Q to exact exponential endpoint trapezoid. The Loewner surplus has Peano representation as the weighted integral of e^{sA}L_A(Q)e^{sA^T}. Rank-one tests force all triples (v,Av,A²v) to be dependent and hence minimal polynomial degree <=2 by the maximal-cyclic-vector lemma. The corresponding rank-two PSD certificate is equivalent to 4a>=b², and completion of squares proves sufficiency. Opposite-sign eigenvalues preclude any nonscalar Hurwitz exception. Exact rational factorization and counterexample calculations passed in the standalone checker; the proof covers infinite quantifiers.

value.rationale: For covariance-propagation schemes, preserving nonnegative output is strictly weaker than furnishing a conservative upper uncertainty envelope. The theorem determines the exact dimension-free drift structure giving universal Loewner overestimation and proves impossibility for every nonscalar stable drift, with explicit rank-one forcing and a positive meshwise consequence. The condition is a nontrivial quadratic minimal-polynomial classification with nonnormal square-zero exceptions, not a scalar midpoint exercise. Limitations to constant input and exact arithmetic are stated.
